scientific_purpose: After original authentic July2014 paired-event probe success, restore same eight immutable original UCI-trained LATFUSE004 checkpoints and same fixed legitimate July FIT event/normal histories; independently reconstruct per-head exact source-conditioned affine memory-transfer kernel P=alpha(I-beta kkT), separate retention-only and key-directed replacement-only survival ratios after H16,64,128,512 real time steps, compare product with actual zero-prefix matrix difference. No new optimizer and no future target read.
source_authority: UCI501 original 12 real Beijing physical station measurements CC BY4.0, original SHA d1b9261c54132f04c374f762f1e5e512af19f95c95fd6bfa1e8ac7e927e3b0b8, input phase FIT through original 2014 end only.
registration_dependencies: LATFUSE005-GENUINE-EVENT-LONG-DELAY-FROZEN-AUDIT immutable RESULTS.json source event/control anchors and original eight trained checkpoint SHA; independent output alongside, no rewriting any previous evidence.
original_recurrent_state: unchanged 1696 FP32+16 bool=6800 bytes, 4×16x4 or2×16x8 heads all 256 associative matrix cells; original checkpoints source trained and hashed
equations: Delta memory for fixed original source and identical non-associative state: Delta M_after=Delta M_anchor * product over time of P_t^h, P_t^h=alpha_h(I-beta_h k_h k_h.T), alpha_h=retention_map sigmoid if eligible source writer otherwise1, beta_h=write_map sigmoid × selected routing probability, zero if not eligible. No new learned read/write weights.
decomposition: Recalculate alpha-only transfer product_h alpha_t I (set beta=0 only in the mathematical transfer), and projection-overwrite-only product_t(I-beta_t k_t k_t.T) (set alpha=1 only in separate source-conditioned transfer). Because scalar alpha commutes within a fixed head, product of these factors composes observed transport mathematically (up to FP32 rounding). No actual model/state intervention implied by decomposition.
observables: All source event+control B actual original 2014 July station/hour source anchors and H16/H64/H128/H512 suffix. Check actual paired original-state memory difference vs independently reconstructed source-conditioned P transport via native trained gate hooks with FP32 tolerance. Report full-matrix remaining norm and separately retention-only, projection-overwrite-only remaining norms and mean gate values, plus per original head. No target labels, artificial events, inference time benchmark or future numeric source.
limitations: This is a source-conditioned linear memory difference attribution, not a proof of useful event recall, a causal do() action model, IEEE-complete theorem, or heldout predictive generalization. Selection/retention dynamics are altered together by soft/hard routes in existing trained models; decomposition is not a newly trained equal-FLOP counterfactual arm.
